description:
Goal: repair the expected fz-hwn.20.4 functionality before publishing seam-specific codegen facts. Boundary contracts must be complete facts derived by the new transport calculator, not lossy summaries or old-model recovery.

Required behavior: callable-shaped leaves crossing a published boundary are represented by a concrete published value lane; tuple return contracts remain tuple contracts instead of collapsing to one broad return lane; direct call surfaces and first-class boundary publication remain separately observable for the same callable when both obligations exist.

Source rule: add source-level worked examples before implementation. Use semantic evidence, settled demand, callable surfaces, capture types, and shared ShapeId descriptors. Do not use old RuntimeValueLayout/DeliveredShape/ReturnAbi/NativeDemandAbi or codegen ArgRepr as authority.

Checks: tests inspect actual BoundaryDescr and CallableFacts contents, not just counts. Telemetry must not claim codegen seam facts until fz-hwn.20.5 creates them. Update outline.md and proposal.html to describe the corrected boundary-contract status.
title: Transport flow graph: complete callable boundary contracts before seam facts
